exempt.ZkServerMain: the core-zk-server executable's entry point: `session` is Core.ZkServer.Loop.main, every other command Core.Protocol.main of Core.ZkServer.protocol, audited under ZkServer and CoreProtocol
exempt.ZkServerDifftest: the core-zk-server-difftest executable's entry point, one line: Difftest.serve over Core.ZkServer.opFn and outerFn, audited under ZkServer and Difftest
exempt.ZkServerHonestDifftestMain: the ZK server-honest-difftest server's entry point, one line: Difftest.serve of ZkServerHonestDifftest.table, which verity/protocols/proofs/flock/prover/tests/test_honest_reqs.py drives against rec_live's requests; audited under ZkServerHonestDifftest

escapes.Core.ZkServer.pyJson: partial def: Python's json.dumps(sort_keys=True) of any JSON value, recursing through it, for the values an open's error message quotes; no proof is about it, and the agreement tests (tests/test_zk_server_release_agreement.py) cover it

ZkServer.why: the release side is code: Lean core and its Std (the wall clock), C-Flock's verifier library (its canonical JSON, SHA-512, the ZK server's contract and its session loop) and the core protocol interface, no Mathlib and nothing of Security (the layout rule: Lean code never requires Security)

ZkServerHonestDifftest.why: the honest worker's requests' port reads C-Flock's Flock.ZkServer.honestReqs and what the ZK server's load check takes, through the harness
